We stayed for 8 days at the 5-star Crystal Green Bay Resort. In terms of the building and interior, it didn’t quite live up to a true 5-star standard—it felt more like a 3.5-star resort. The sunbeds are very basic and don’t have cushions, and the furniture both indoors and in the restaurant is somewhat outdated. The toilet didn’t flush properly, and although the rooms have clearly been renovated, it looks like it was done rather hastily and without much attention to detail. The music from the speakers is quite distorted, and they definitely need replacing. In the evenings, the lighting is too bright, and there isn’t much in terms of proper entertainment or shows. At dinner time, especially right when the restaurant opens, you often have to deal with long queues. That said, there are also many positives. The staff are incredibly friendly and helpful—we truly felt very welcome throughout our stay. The cocktails are excellent and generously poured, with more than enough alcohol. There are bars conveniently located everywhere, whether you’re at the beach or by the pool, and you can grab as many bottles of water as you like from the coolers at each bar. Food is available throughout the entire day, with something open at all times, and there are always ice creams available as well. The food is delicious with plenty of variety, though it can sometimes be a bit cold. A nice touch is that you’re allowed to take your food back to your room or enjoy it on the beach. The resort is beautifully located in a bay, which means the sea is calm and perfect for swimming. There are also plenty of sunbeds available, so there’s no need to reserve them early with towels. If you like animals, you’ll enjoy the many cats walking around during mealtimes—they’re very sweet and not intrusive at all. The resort is suitable for adults, with or without children, as well as younger guests who enjoy a lively atmosphere. We paid €600 for 8 days all-inclusive, including flights, transfer, and insurance, and it was absolutely worth every penny. We had a fantastic time. Thank you to everyone at Crystal Green Bay!

Thought long about the rating I was going to give this hotel in my review. It all started with a 5, dropped to 2 in between and finally decided to give it a 3. First of all, our tour agency did not mention any word about the hotel closing while we bought the trip, so we found out on the third day there that it will be closing on our last day. Spent there sixteen days at mid-October. In the first six days everything was good, food variety was excellent, food was always restocked during meals, there were enough drink selections and so on, just as you would expect from an ultra all-inclusive type. About ten days before closing, the closing procedures began. We were in the middle of packing, so not really relaxing mood. For example, there was no rum left at the hotel anymore, ten days more to go and that was finished for the season. Also the ice cream fridge was gone, two bars closed and most beach chairs moved away. Main restaurant food variety and amounts too reduced, sometimes food was cold. Day by day the spaces between cake platters got wider at the cake stand. In the last days the white wine, gin and vodka were running out too, the bartenders were searching from other bars and back to see if there were some leftover bottles, sometimes they found some, but sometimes not. Actually the staff was friendly, sometimes tired from the season, but still caring. Some entertainment was left, like darts and rifle shooting, the guy was actually enthusiastic and wanted to arrange the games. The hotel is really remote, there is about 4km to the next small town along a narrow road, most probably with dogs, as seen from the taxi window. The yellow taxi prices have increased a lot, it was 10TL to sit in and about 30TL for the kilometer fee, so about 700TL to Bodrum one way. What was good about the hotel, were the evening shows and live bands, which we had the opportunity to see in the first part of the trip, later the shows were finished as well. Good quality and level of shows and bands. The DJ/sound technician did a very good job too. We also went on Jimmy's boat. If you like to have many swimming breaks at different places along the nearby coast and just chill, then it is the boat trip for you. The boat crew was very friendly and provided a wonderful meal with a kind atmosphere. On the hotel premises there were many dogs, cats and a few puppies, but they did not bother us, it was fun that they were there. The room and other areas were cleaned properly and no complaints about that. But no wine and fruit in room for birthday, as seen on other quests' photos on Tripadvisor. It was sweet of the hotel to provide food from the snack bar after lunch until the evening and some drinks that they had left on the final closing day.

The next morning my wife and I had a superb selection of breakfast dishes and was spoiled my very helpful staff. We walked around the hotel and loved the piece and quite of the hotel as there were not hotels either side of this one. My wife and I have back problems and found the bed to be on the hard side, we spoke with the staff at the desk and within in an hour they had put a mattress topper to make the be softer (unfortunately it was still too hard). The rooms were cleaned and our towels were changed when we needed them to be. The evening entertainment was enjoyable especially the fire act. Would I recommend this hotel? The answer is an over willming yes, there were a few things that could be improved but they are so minor that it did not affect our stay, after our two weeks were finished, we wanted to stay longer because we were made to feel at home. Thank you for a wonderful and memorable stay.

Stay at crystal Green Bay hotel for 7 days. The hotel is fantastic, in a beautiful location and the staff couldn’t help enough. The entertainment team “Ismail” were great. I would highly recommend this place. Relaxed, entertainment and nothing bad about the place, location or staff.

After reading all the amazing reviews I was so looking forward to this holiday. How disappointed I was! Thinking we was staying at a 5* hotel. This hotel was definitely not 5* I would say a decent 3* max! *Rooms - our room was tiny with literally hardly any space to hang clothes, no drawers to put anything in so we lived out of suitcases. Which is fine. The bed is a good size but very hard mattress but the annoying thing is the blanket did not fit the bed, didn't even reach the edges. Cleaners came in daily to make the bed sweep and mop floor but 3 times had to go looking for toilet rolls. On one occasion got in shower to realise we had no towels at all. Air conditioning was very good had to turn it off through the night cos it's above the bed so would wake up freezing. Also found it really strange there was no ceiling light over the main part of room. Just bed side lamps so was really dark of an evening( didn't help out balcony had a tree for a view so had no natural light either). Overall though l, it served its purpose. Food - very repetitive. I'm a veggie and it was literally same thing every other day. Rest of our party are meat eaters. There was plenty of choice but it seemed to be repeated every few days so the menu was very samey! However the burger bar next to pool was nice, as was the waffle bar. And the snack bar (next to main restaurant) however you'd be lucky if you got what you ordered! Ice creams were lovely. Grounds - grounds it self are well looked after and kept clean. Views are stunning. Beach is stoney so suggest beach shoes to get into water. Plenty of beds. Views are stunning. Plenty of bars but club triangle disco bar was not open once while we was there. There is a shop on site but very expensive but they always are in hotels. Pools are ok and clean and slides are good for kids. However the tiles surrounding them are extremely dangerous. The amount of people that would slip and fall each day was rediculous. My sister slipped at the kids pool.and dislocated her shoulder. There are no life guards ( accept the slides) at any of the pools. I had to get someone from the kids club to get a first aider who called an ambulance. When asked for a copy of incident report later we was refused and told that no one has ever fallen before. However we had seen it own eyes. Next day there were wet floor signs everywhere and a sign up saying no lifeguard. At the main pool there are a couple of mats to walk on but don't cover all the main walk ways. I think if they just spent the money making it safe it would be so much better. Entertainment - the shows that we saw.at the amphitheatre were good, however it's the same every week so if you are there for 2 weeks your watching the same.thing. at other hotels it's always been a 2 week cycle so it's something different every night. Nice kids play areas but no lighting so when kids are still playing it's very dark. Either need lighting or close park as it's not safe. My niece (2years) did en

Definitely not UK 5 star! I would say 3.5-4 at best. We were initially checked in to a room that was awful and stank of damp and all we could hear was the dance music from the amphitheatre. We complained immediately and were moved to a better, quieter room. The decor of the room was extremely dated and was very worn! Our bathroom had quite a bit of black mould. The lift's emergency phone had the wires cut and there was no emergency button! Jimmy was very pushy and didn't take no for an answer until we made it rudely clear we were not interested. Don't book a massage here! Whilst the girls who gave the massages were lovely, we had a couples massage and the ladies talked amongst themselves throughout the whole thing and their phones kept pinging. Not relaxing at all. After the massage, you are taken to an area to relax and have some lovely Turkish tea which was lovely until the spa manager came up to us asking how we found the massage and if we booked another, he could offer us a discount. Completely stopped the feeling of relaxation. We kept being pestered throughout the rest of the holiday, to book another massage. Very pushy. The staff in the main buffet restaurant were lovely and couldn't do enough for guests! The ladies cooking the Gozleme were amazing and I highly recommend trying them. We ended up having one nearly every day! Also the room cleaning staff were lovely and went out of their way to look after us. A lot of the staff struggled with English but we were able to communicate fine as we had a phrasebook.

This is the second year we have been to the Crystal Green Bay resort. We were not disappointed. A lovely room upgrade for repeat visit and some lovely extras in our room for our 25th wedding anniversary. The rooms are spacious and super clean with a well stocked mini bar. The hotel staff are super welcoming and do a fabulous job keeping up the hotels high standards. Nothing is too much trouble here. There is so much food, something for everyone. The spa is excellent, the massages are awesome and the hamam experience is second to none. We can not wait to return to this wonderful green oasis next year.

Very friendly staff and a great atmosphere. Food was great and the beach very relaxing. We had a great time and the amphitheatre was excellent I’d recommend to couples and families . There was a variety of bars and restaurants

Visited here recently with my twin sister for seven nights. The hotel was very quiet which was perfect for us as we were searching for a very chilled holiday. We took part in yoga, aqua Zumba and aqua bikes which were fun however on the Monday it said there was aqua bikes but this didn’t happen which was a shame :( The staff were very friendly and welcoming but did not bug you if you didn’t not want to engage which we liked. There was a language barrier however as most of them didn’t tend to speak any English. The food was amazing- we’re both vegetarians and we found enough options every meal time. The desserts were also great- a range of options. We didn’t book any of the restaurant Al La Carte as we preferred the buffets. The WiFi is also very good and fast. The slides are very fun and the two pools are really good size. The hotel entertainment was some of the best I have ever seen- very high standards of acrobatics/gymnastics/dancing. Downsides: I wouldn’t say it was quite a five star resort for the following reasons: -the gym area is very poor- it looks like a store room or something that was started and never finished! Lack of equipment and very few useable weights. - stand up paddle boards being available at a chargeable rate- these have always been free at other all inclusive resorts. - big dogs lingering around all the time on the beach and the pool. I appreciate this is an issue in Turkey however it’s not nice seeing them drink from the pools! - people kept bringing their babies and kids to the ‘adult only’ pools. -I think the cocktail menu was very poor for a 5 star- very limited choice. I only liked two of them. - rooms are nice but outdated in my opinion. -the beach’s aren’t the cleanest sometimes with fags everywhere. The sand isn’t the nicest. However we still had a lovely week there and would recommend to anyone whose looking for a holiday in this area :)

Had a really good time here. The pools are big, plenty of sun beds about and the evening shows were pretty good by hotel standards, the Mongolian circus and the Colombian dancers were very good. The animation team are good and try to get people involved throughout the day, we did yoga, aqua Zumba and the aqua bikes but there wasn’t any yoga or aqua bike for the last few days we was there and wasn’t sure why as we enjoyed it :( The staff are also friendly but there is a language barrier and sometimes they did not understand what I was asking for at the bar. We really enjoyed the food and the desserts each night were unreal, there’s waffles and ice cream throughout the day available so never short on getting a treat somewhere. We didn’t bother trying the a la carte as couldn’t get reservation working from QR code but wasn’t that bothered Some downsides are that there was a couple stray dogs about, we really didn’t like that. They seemed harmless enough but just hate stray animals. And secondly, the gym for a five star resort is abysmal and looked like a half finished room so deffo needs some attention. The beach also isn’t the prettiest I’ve ever saw but we loved the pool areas for the days anyway We enjoyed the whole week here though and also loved the slides
